# `Input` of RGSS3 measured on the original runtime of VX Ace (RGSS301.dll 3.0.1.1,
# 2026-10-13, report `ace-v1-sprite-REPORT.md`; RGSS300.dll 3.0.0.1 answers by the same model):
# 12084 updates of the real module driven through the keyboard, in 25 scripted sequences and
# three random ones, the probe of `rgss2-input-samples.txt`. Checked by
# `ace-v1-sprite-input-model.py`, the model of RGSS2 fed with the held buttons the original
# reported, without a mismatch.
#
#   stream NAME                 everything is released and 8 updates pass, whose answers are
#                               not listed; what the state keeps beyond that carries over
#   update P T R DIR4 DIR8      one `Input.update` after a shown frame, with the buttons of P
#                               held, and the answers after it: `press?`, `trigger?` and
#                               `repeat?` as one digit for each of DOWN LEFT RIGHT UP C B A X
#                               SHIFT, then `dir4`, `dir8`
#   keep P T R DIR4 DIR8        a frame without `Input.update`: the answers as they are
#   ... xN                      the line stands N times
#
# The held buttons of an update are the `press?` the original answered after it, not the
# keys sent before it: RGSS3 sees a key only once a call of `Graphics` that shows a frame
# has taken its window message, which can be an update later than the key was sent.
# The Shift key holds A and SHIFT, so both digits are set together.
